description:
Cast Doppelgang by paying {3}{G}{U}, targeting a permanent.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Doppelgang, targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Doppelgang, creating a token copy of Naru Meha.
Put either Naru Meha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat from step 3.
